spans.s: SR0127 गण्डः gaṇḍaḥ Zygoma/Cheek - The long arch that joins zygomatic processes of the temporal and molar bones on the sides of the skull.
SR0128 गण्डकः gaṇḍakaḥ Groin. The depression between thigh and trunk.
AF0757 गण्डूपदमुखसदृश करीर gaṇḍūpadamukhasadṛśa karīra Sprout like projection resembling the mouth of earth worm
SV0098 गण्डूष gaṇḍūṣa Filling the mouth to its full capacity with liquid (medicinal decoctions/Luke warm water/medicinal oils) without allowing its movement.
